data.name: Dalchand
data.long_meaning: Dal means servant and Chand means God. Dalchand is a name given to those who are devoted to God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a devotee, symbolizing complete surrender to the divine.

in_sanskrit.name: दल्ल्चन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: दल् (dal) - to strike, चन् (chan) - to be, दन् (dan) - to give, धन् (dhana) - wealth, चन्द्र (chand) - moon, तुल् (tul) - auspicious, सर् (sar) - king
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives auspicious wealth like the moon strikes or appears

in_hindi.name: दल्ल्चन्द
in_hindi.meaning: दल् (dal) - दूर से चढ़ाना, चन् (chan) - होना, दन् (dan) - दान, धन् (dhana) - धन, चन्द्र (chand) - चंद्रमा, तुल् (tul) - शुभ, सर् (sar) - राजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings auspicious wealth from far away, just like the moon, is a king

in_tamil.name: தல்ல்சந்த
in_tamil.meaning: தல் (thal) - அல்லவாக் கொடுத்து, சந் (san) - செய்யும், தன் (than) - இன், தன் (dan) - தோல்வில், அர் (ar) - அவர், சந்திரம் (chandram) - சந்திரம், துல் (tul) - வியுத்தம், சர் (char) - சாங்கரம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who performs (for others) the act of giving (with a pure heart), like the moon (which is a symbol of generosity), is a wise and powerful king

in_telugu.name: దల్ల్చన్ద
in_telugu.meaning: దల్ (dal) - దూరమేదై చేయిపోయిదు, చన్ (chan) - హోయిపోయిదు, దన్ (dan) - దానము, ధన్ (dhana) - ధనము, చన్ద్ర (chandru) - చంద్రము, తుళ్ (tul) - శుభము, సర్ (sar) - శహీదర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who brings (wealth) from afar, just like the moon, is a generous and powerful king

in_marathi.name: Dalchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dalchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dal means servant and Chand means God. Dalchand is a name given to those who are devoted to God.

in_bengali.name: Dalchand
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Servant of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dalchand একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dal means servant and Chand means God. Dalchand is a name given to those who are devoted to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dalchand reflects the deep devotion and faith that Hindus have towards their deities. It is a name that emphasizes the concept of serving God, which is a fundamental tenet of Hinduism. The name is also a reminder of the Hindus' belief in the divine presence in all beings, encouraging the practice of selflessness and unwavering devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dalchand holds immense spiritual significance for Hindus as it represents an embodiment of the fundamental principles of selfless devotion and submission to the divine. It is a name that serves as a constant reminder to its bearer to strive towards spiritual growth by serving and connecting with God at all times. The name also instills a sense of humility and reverence towards the divine, encouraging individuals to lead virtuous and god-centered lives.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dalchand was a Jain Tirthankara of the 12th cycle of Jainism, born in the Siddhakalpa era. The name Dalchand carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Dalchand continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Maya Dalchand in Mumbai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Dalchand, which means "Servant of God". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Dalchand: Prosperity embodied, radiating abundance and generosity. The name Dalchand signifies one who is a reservoir of wealth and blessings, constantly overflowing with the spirit of giving and nurturing prosperity.
